messages.text: The banana bread I got was dry and overpriced. I found a competitor offering it for less. How are you going to compensate me for this poor quality?

I am so sorry to hear that your banana bread did not meet your expectations; we truly want you to be happy! I would be glad to offer you a complimentary dessert, up to $6, to make up for the poor experience. Please let me know what else we can get for you today!
$6 is too low. My friend's place has a better deal. I want a full refund or a free cappuccino.

I truly want to ensure your experience here is wonderful, and while I cannot process a full refund, I would be delighted to give you a complimentary cappuccino today. Please accept this as our sincere apology for the inconvenience. Can I get you anything else to complete your order while you enjoy this special treat?
A free cappuccino is not enough. I want a discount that reflects the price difference at other places or I'm going somewhere else.

I truly apologize that we could not meet your price expectations today; however, I would be delighted to offer you a $6 credit toward any item in our cafe right now. Would you be interested in trying our almond croissant, which is usually $4.50? We would love for you to have a better experience with us!
